ui.SectionHints.350b2ff99969bb1c: The selected recognition job is shown here. “Start” starts the prepared queue, “Pause” stops sending new requests, “Stop” finishes the job. A request that has already been sent may still complete after being stopped. The previous launch can be selected in the history below.
ui.SectionHints.21431333e0014a01: The percentage of completed elements of the selected task, rather than the readiness of one neural network request. The counters in the summary show how many photos are ready, waiting, running, or failed. 100% means completion of items, not no errors. The service waiting time does not provide a separate smooth percentage.
ui.SectionHints.58120c0fc98408f8: Photos of the selected task and the status of each: waiting, processing, finished result or error. “Hide completed” removes only successfully completed items from this list only; errors remain visible. The task, its results and original photographs are saved.
ui.SectionHints.54127eddc7f20e80: Status of the selected run, photo in operation and total counters. After completion, the result of the task remains here. The summary is for a single run; total expenses for the entire history are in the “Expenses” group.
ui.SectionHints.a6f8a0fa751cde33: Service, model and parameters with which the selected job is prepared. New job settings do not change this snapshot. The concurrent request limit can be changed for a pending cloud job; Locally, one photo is taken at a time.
ui.SectionHints.d7f57f7cbe28c560: Previous launches with date, model, condition and photos. Expand the launch to see its composition. "Open Launch" shows its queue and options above; this button does not restart processing.
ui.SectionHints.1fb6427e30b1cdb2: Accounted costs of recognition and editing for the entire saved history. The confirmed cost is separated from the estimate and reserve of requests with an unknown price. These are application statistics, not the service account balance; deleting history changes it.
ui.SectionHints.4b6f3204e3c78cad: Photo editing tasks: model, condition, date, duration, dimensions and results. You can open a saved project or a finished frame. Opening a project does not submit a new edit; continuation and cancellation are performed with separate commands.
ui.SectionHints.79464c9eae05020a: Index is a list of photos, paths, descriptions and tags saved on the computer. It remains after the program is closed. “Refresh” clarifies information about the database; This button does not start photo recognition. Sources and services are in the groups below.
ui.SectionHints.98f00e0046dda393: Folders connected as library sources. The update adds information about new and changed files, preserving the descriptions. Auto-update and exceptions can be configured for each source. Connecting or disconnecting a source does not delete the originals or trigger OCR.
ui.SectionHints.72bb3992a997bb5e: Index entries for which the file is unavailable, the path has changed, or requires verification. Select a condition and update the list. Path checking does not run the neural network. Removing from the index removes the stored entry, so check your selections before this separate command.
ui.SectionHints.87d294efa58de5db: Copies of the same file with the same content, even if the names or folders are different. This is not a search for similar stories. Before operations with copies, files are checked; viewing and comparing do not delete photos.
ui.SectionHints.be1c2e00c59f9799: The copy of the index preserves descriptions, tags, collections, and history, but not the external originals and API keys. The full copy also includes designs, masks and editor images. Recovery replaces the corresponding data after a restart; check the selected copy first.
ui.SectionHints.1f19aecab6e67819: The full copy combines the editor's index and storage: projects, history, results and masks. External originals and keys API are not included. Selecting a copy first checks its composition; recovery is applied after restart, preserving the previous storage.
ui.SectionHints.b78e1c9601927ad4: Pre-made thumbnails speed up the re-display of photos. Cleaning removes only these previews: the originals, descriptions and tags remain. The next time you view it, the required thumbnails are created again. This shows the cache size and its limitations.
ui.SectionHints.59ffdf44e6c4c2f8: Path, version, and service information of the index database for diagnostics and backup. The base path is not the original photos folder. Expanding the group itself does not change anything in the files or index.
ui.SectionHints.662a2ff0b698447d: Adding and removing tags from selected photos. Check the preview first, then apply the changes. Descriptions are saved; physical copies of the same photo share its tags. You can change up to 256 different photos in one operation.
ui.SectionHints.98427510da0a40bc: Export description and tags to a separate file XMP next to each selected photo. Images are not overwritten and existing XMP images are not replaced. Such files can be transferred along with the photo to programs that support XMP.
ui.SectionHints.b715aebc3d1c4d57: Choose where to save the finished images: next to the source, in a specified folder, or with a question each time you save. Projects and cache have separate repositories. The transfer checks the new copy before switching and leaves the old folder.
ui.SectionHints.45fe3557333b2f5e: The editor's project storage and preview cache are moved separately. Close the editor before transferring projects. The application will check the copy and keep the previous folder; keys API and general models Ollama are not moved by this action.
ui.SectionHints.d803b638dd0c8a83: For a selected saved cloud job: replacing the key and checking the outcome of requests after a communication failure. Checking a known query does not create a new generation. Continuing a task is a separate action; a request without a confirmed outcome requires reconciliation.
ui.SectionHints.44f878a96cf7dd92: Requests for which the result or cost has not been confirmed. By ID you can check the status of the service. If the ID is not received, first check the service account: a repetition may lead to additional payment. Manual confirmation only applies to the selected attempt.
ui.SectionHints.0890229ca2b43812: Select the recognition service, model level, and the result to save: description, tags, or both fields. Cloud services receive prepared photos and require a separate key. The local model is installed only at your command.
ui.SectionHints.2de7174ac7434218: Settings for the following tasks: number of photos, budget, passes and error repetitions. "Concurrent in the cloud" sets the limit of concurrent requests, not the size of the entire queue. One photo is processed locally; an already prepared task stores its own parameters.
ui.SectionHints.9f9c56ae102d3b48: The saved description of the selected photo can be edited manually. Changes are saved with a separate button, without accessing the neural network. When updating a result in the background, unsaved text is not automatically replaced.
ui.SectionHints.44a0a6929b4c8f97: Events of changes in data and program actions. Select one photo or the entire library, then expand the event for details. The log helps you check what happened; viewing it does not repeat the recorded action.
